text:
A plastic rod is brought near to a small plastic sphere suspended from a stand. The sphere is
repelled by the rod.
Why is this?
A
The rod and the sphere have like charges.
B
The rod and the sphere have unlike charges.
C
The rod is charged and the sphere is uncharged.
D
The rod is uncharged and the sphere is charged.

options.label: A
options.text: The rod and the sphere have like charges.

options.label: B
options.text: The rod and the sphere have unlike charges.

options.label: C
options.text: The rod is charged and the sphere is uncharged.

options.label: D
options.text: The rod is uncharged and the sphere is charged.
